subject: Demo: Redwood Inference — scheduling with VP/CTO

Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference — scheduling with VP/CTO

Hi Amy,

Thanks for the interest — excited to show a tailored walkthrough of Redwood for your data platform team. Quick availability from our side:

- Tue 24 Feb, 11:00 AM PT
- Wed 25 Feb, 10:00 AM PT
- Thu 26 Feb, 10:00 AM PT or 2:00 PM PT

Dylan (cc'd) will run the demo and focus on latency/cost controls and dedicated deployment options. If you have an executive sponsor who wants to join, we can prioritize a shorter exec overview + Q&A.

Do any of those times work? If you prefer, share Dan's availability (or forward his calendar) and we'll align.

Best,

Laura Bennett

laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@saasco.com>

Hi Laura,

Thanks — Tue 24 Feb at 11:00 AM PT works for our core team. Our CTO, Dan Park, asked if he could join for the first 30–45 minutes to hear the executive overview and ask a couple of high-level questions. Dan's calendar is tight but he has a window 11:30 AM–12:15 PM PT that day.

Would it be possible to either start a half hour earlier (10:30) or keep the first 45 minutes to the executive overview so Dan can hop in at 11:30? Happy to coordinate.

Best,

amy.chen@saasco.com

Heads up — I'm traveling that week and won't be available on Tue 24 until late afternoon. If Laura needs me for the executive intro / to backstop the brief exec Q&A, I can do Thu 26 Feb 10:00–11:00 AM PT.

If the external team needs a CTO-level presence earlier, I can try to dial in from the airport but prefer to avoid given spotty connection.

-Marcus

Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — scheduling with VP/CTO

Thanks for the context, Amy — appreciate the heads up on Dan's window. Marcus is traveling and can't make the 24th morning, so to ensure an exec is present for the overview, would Thu 26 Feb at 10:00 AM PT work for you and the team? That would allow Marcus to join in-person and give a 20–25 minute executive overview before handing to Dylan for the deep dive.

If Dan can only be there at 11:30 on the 24th, I worry the overlap will be too small to give a proper executive alignment. If Thu 26 is not possible, we can still run the demo on Tue 24 with Marcus dialing in remotely (we'll confirm connectivity) and prioritize the executive topics first.

Please let me know what the preferred path is — reschedule to Thu 26 10:00 AM PT (preferred, exec present) or keep Tue 24 11:00 AM PT with Marcus joining remotely and Dan popping in late.

Also attaching the deck and a one-pager for execs so Dan can review quickly before the session.

Best,
Laura

Amy
